jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Experimental Biology)
jobs.content: <p>The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research.</p><ul><li>Design, execute, and iterate on the experimental programs at the core of the team&#39;s research: molecular biology, biochemistry, protein and nucleic acid characterization, high-throughput functional screens, and assay development.</li><li>Have a Ph.D. in a biological science (molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, computational biology) or a related field.</li><li>Familiarity with biological databases (UniProt, GenBank, PDB) and computational biology tools.</li></ul><p>We do sponsor visas! However, we aren&#39;t able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate.</p>

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Computational Biology
jobs.content: <p>Deep computational biology expertise with frontier AI. Strong proficiency in Python; machine learning; metagenomics, single-cell genomics or protein design. PhD in computational biology or bioinformatics.</p>

location.name: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Biosecurity
jobs.content: <p>A PhD in molecular biology, virology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related life sciences field. Deep expertise in modern biology including high-throughput measurement, functional assays, gene synthesis, genome editing and strain construction. Experience with dual-use research and biosafety (BSL-3).</p>

jobs.title: Research Engineer Intern, Machine Learning (Summer 2027)
jobs.content: <p>Work with researchers on large language model training and interpretability in PyTorch. Open to students graduating in 2027.</p>

jobs.title: Anthropic Fellows Program — AI Safety Fellow
jobs.content: <p>A four-month, full-time, paid fellowship on AI safety research with mentorship and compute. You don't need a PhD.</p>
